description: The classy and elegant Skandinavia Country Club is located in the picturesque beach town of Sestroretsk, just a short distance from the shores of the Baltic Sea. The hotel consists of three units: the 5-star historical suites of Dacha Shelepin, the 5-star Dacha Likhachev with comfortable apartments and the 3-star Skandinavia next to the swimming pool. The hotel has been decorated and furnished in the style of a Russian country retreat. An ideal spot for a weekend getaway or a relaxing trip to the country, Skandinavia Country Club has a wide range of leisure activities on offer. There is an outdoor heated swimming pool and a spa bath. There is also a fantastic spa with a range of treatments and massages on offer. Guests can choose between the 2 restaurants, offering a variety of international cuisines alongside many Russian specialities. There is also a selection of fine wines to choose from. Skandinavia Country Club is situated just 35 km north of Saint Petersburg. Please inform Skandinavia Country Club and SPA in advance of your expected arrival time. You can use the Special Requests box when booking, or contact the property directly with the contact details provided in your confirmation. Guests are required to show a photo identification and credit card upon check-in. Please note that all Special Requests are subject to availability and additional charges may apply. In response to Coronavirus (COVID-19), additional safety and sanitation measures are in effect at this property. Due to Coronavirus (COVID-19), this property is taking steps to help protect the safety of guests and staff. Certain services and amenities may be reduced or unavailable as a result. Guests need to meet one or more requirements to stay in this property: proof of full Coronavirus (Covid-19) vaccination, a recent valid negative Coronavirus PCR test, or recent proof of Coronavirus recovery. Please note that each guest is required to show a passport upon check-in. Please note that heated swimming pool and a spa bath are available for guests free of charge from 09:00 until 00:00. Please note that access to the swimming pool and to the spa bath from 09:00 until 00:00 is included in the rate. When travelling with pets, please note that an extra charge of RUB 3000 per pet, per stay applies. Pets can only be accommodated in the 3-star buildings standard and junior suite rooms. The room rate includes a visit to the Bath complex: Russian, Turkish and Finnish steam rooms from 10:00 to 18:00, and after 19:00 they can be booked individually for an additional payment. As well as an open-air swimming pool with heating + 28C andd a jacuzzi + 37C from 9:00 to 24:00 The name on the credit card used for the booking should correspond to the guest staying at the property, if not followed payment will be collected during check in, and the deposit refunded.
